# Agent 900: Fixture agent

**What it does:** exists so the validate rules have something that passes.

## How it works

One field, one quote.

## Results

Tested on 20 synthetic documents in the fixture corpus. Results are produced by the test-suite with a fake provider.

## The human gate

The supervising associate reviews every item before any value is copied into the tracker.

## Run it yourself

This agent is a test fixture; run `uv run pytest`.
